crossRefs.note: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

translations.web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
translations.bsb: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
translations.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
translations.asv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.
